answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bonded through a bridge that links its on-chain history to one verified compute record, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes instead of one free signup. A newcomer earns trust only after a comet-like trail of completed, attested jobs accumulates under that single identity, and each attestation is signed like a quill signature that cannot be copied to a fresh clone. Misbehavior slashes the stake, so a sybil farm pays real money per identity and loses it on first abuse.
